name: Vinesauce ROM Corruptor
description: Classic ROM-corruptor algorithm: repeatedly overwrites randomly placed, randomly sized runs of bytes until roughly the chosen intensity of the file has been touched, while preserving a header region so the ROM often still boots. NOTE: this is a best-effort recreation of the well-known public Vinesauce corruptor algorithm (intensity % + min/max block size + header preservation + optional seed) — not a byte-for-byte port of a specific fork's source, since that source wasn't accessible while building this. Adjust parameters/defaults freely, or re-import an updated version of this file if your fork's exact behavior differs.
author: Vinesauce community (recreated)

parameters.label: Corruption Intensity
parameters.description: Roughly what percentage of the ROM (outside the header) ends up touched.

parameters.label: Header Size
parameters.description: Bytes to leave untouched at the start of the file — e.g. 16 for an iNES-header NES ROM, 512 for some SNES copier headers, 0 for a headerless ROM.

parameters.label: Use Fixed Seed
parameters.description: Reuse the same seed to reproduce identical corruption on identical input.
